title: Payload — verification.claim_created
$comment: Signed by a verifier for delegated types, by the subject itself for self-verifiable ones. Publishing grants nothing — authority lives in whether a consumer recognizes the signer. additionalProperties is true by design: the versioning rules require that a new optional field survives a node that cannot interpret it, preserved byte-exactly for the digest. Every envelope field name is forbidden here (set to false): the convention that a payload never duplicates the envelope is enforced by the schema, not left to prose.

then.$comment: A claim grants authority over the identifier it names, and nothing else.

else.$comment: email, human and purchase are about a subject, not about an entity.
